references.title: Catalogue and project panel
references.author: Bernardo Lickfold
references.observation: Even at mobile width the catalogue retains pairs of portrait images. The project panel uses a paragraph, a short metadata table, then stacked project imagery.
references.mode: Original system expansion; source image retained only as evidence

references.title: Structure before imagery
references.author: Bernardo Lickfold
references.observation: The desktop version reserves a narrow information rail beside tall photo panels. The mobile example keeps a photo pair above the copy and metadata, preserving their shared edges.
references.mode: Original system expansion; source image retained only as evidence

references.title: A shared horizontal hinge
references.author: Bernardo Lickfold
references.observation: A deep blank upper band separates navigation from the main content. The headline and small food image begin on the same line as the large room photograph. Short copy sits just above that line on the right.
references.mode: Original system expansion; source image retained only as evidence

references.title: Images beside an index
references.author: Bernardo Lickfold
references.observation: A large blank band follows the header. Below it, stacked portraits occupy the left side while a numbered list occupies the right. One list item is darker to show the active project.
references.mode: Original system expansion; source image retained only as evidence
